XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Loss of information or anomaly in the recording of the car's mileage

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars manufactured from 18/03/19 to 24/03/22

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: ABS-ESP control unit (1094)

  • Fault: Loss or alteration of information relating to the vehicle's mileage or distance travelled

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: A software error in the ABS-ESP control unit (1094) prevents the control unit from correctly storing mileage information

• Intervention: Reprogram and update the ABS-ESP control unit (1094)

  • Procedure: First, check the status of the SHUNT fuse. If you find a fault in the SHUNT fuse assembly, or if the fuse itself is damaged, replace it.
    If there are no faults in the SHUNT fuse, proceed with reprogramming and updating the ABS-ESP control unit (1094).

  • Notes: Using a diagnostic tool, verify that all related systems are functioning correctly. If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.
